title: DOMAIN — applying ingress snapshots
summary: Explore of the DOMAIN handler inside the Functions container: address and project-price snapshots from Ingress SNAPSHOT are applied to domain storage and, for address changes, follow-up project commands are sent to the command queue. Open “Apply ingress snapshots” for the detailed sub-layer. Arrows explain responsibilities, not execution order or observed events.
